KEYS
  panels
  tab                  focus the next panel; inside Work's columns (Kanban), the next column (shift-tab the previous)
  shift-tab            focus the previous panel
  F5                   health
  F6                   ideas
  ^P                   the command palette: the line opened with /, every command searchable (also i then /)
  1-3                  view
  1-4                  view
  ←→                   the lower panel's previous or next tab (Activity, Board, Work), wrapping
  ↑↓ j k               select
  pgup                 page up
  pgdn                 page down
  home g               first row
  end G                live
  end G                last row
  enter v              detail
  y                    copy
  f                    auto-scroll
  u                    Activity: the next unread message for you (●), wrapping
  T                    triage: open what waits for you one item at a time, the next after each answer or send (n next, p back, esc ends); not t, the tour
  ! F4                 answer
  w                    answer the open question, or with none open write to master
  Z                    put the project to sleep (agentbus suspend), or, when it is suspended, bring it back (agentbus resume); asks first
  d del                remove
  a                    show or hide the agents silent for more than a day
  o                    Requests: show or hide the answered threads and those older than 7 days
  + -                  Requests: raise or lower a tracked request's priority (low, normal, high); agents take the high ones first
  /                    filter
  i :                  write
  I                    write in the compose window (several lines, Ctrl+S sends)
  esc                  back
  F2 r                 requests
  F3 s                 services
  R                    where was I? open the project recap
  p P                  the batch's plan in a drawer: NOW, NEXT, LATER, DONE, the progress; enter opens a task, d shows done, esc closes
  d                    Work: the plan with its done tasks (the drawer; d there folds them)
  U                    tokens: the account windows, every project side by side, this project by agent
  C                    settings: display, attention and your name, changed in config.toml
  M                    projects: every project of this host, its state, agents, keys, services and herdr workspace; sleep, stop or back one up
  H                    history: re-read the past, the archive on this host then the live streams (enter opens an entry)
  A                    about: busmon's, agentbus's and Redis's versions (y copies them), and the bus at work
  F1 ?                 help
  q                    quit
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  writing a message
  ^O alt-enter         several lines
  enter                send
  tab                  complete @agent
  esc                  back (draft kept)
  ←→ home end          move the cursor by character or to either end (^A ^E too); del deletes at it, ^W back to a word, ^U to the start
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  editing the filter
  enter                apply
  esc                  cancel
  ←→ home end          move the cursor by character or to either end (^A ^E too); del deletes at it, ^W back to a word, ^U to the start
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  an open detail
  F5                   health
  F6                   ideas
  ^P                   the command palette, from any page
  ↑↓ j k               scroll
  pgup                 page up
  pgdn                 page down
  home g               first row
  end G                last row
  y                    copy
  Y                    copy the whole thread (a message's page) or the whole report (an agent's page, a recap item's)
  n p ←→               the next or previous item of the list the page was opened from, as it was then (reopen to see newer lines)
  enter ! w            answer the agent's open questions (w with none open: write to master)
  t                    in the help: the first-launch tour again; in History (H): the selected entry's thread
  /                    History (H): filter by @agent, a thread id or words
  enter s              on a plan task waiting for you: start the discussion with master (the compose window, prefilled)
  a                    Health (F5): show or hide the fine checks (enter opens a check in place, y copies a For-you check's command)
  a                    Ideas (F6): add an idea in the compose window, its first line the title (it starts at to discuss)
  s                    Ideas (F6) or an idea's page: the state picker under the idea (↑↓ choose, y sets it as you, esc cancels)
  tab                  Ideas (F6): show one state, then the next, then all
  o                    History (H): load the three days before; the recap (R): show For you's items older than a day
  r                    About (A): play the packet's run again
  d                    the plan (p): show or fold the done tasks
  l                    Services (F3): the selected service's log (enter too; ↑↓ choose the card, ←→ too when side by side)
  esc q                close
  + -                  a tracked request's page: raise or lower its priority (low, normal, high)
  r i I                reply in the compose window: on an agent's page to that agent; on a message, report or note page to its sender, an agent, prefilled with re: and its first line
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  answering questions
  ↑↓ j k               choose
  1-9                  choose an option by its number
  enter                answer
  ←→ tab               question
  y                    copy
  ?                    help
  esc                  close
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  the settings page (C)
  ^P                   the command palette (not while a value is being edited)
  ↑↓ j k               the groups (or the keys, with the focus there); on a narrow page ↓ from the tabs goes to the keys, ↑ on the first key back
  ←→                   → into the keys, ← back to the groups (a narrow page: they step the tabs); on an open choice they change its value
  tab                  move the focus between the groups and the keys
  enter                on a group: go to its keys; on a key: flip an on/off, open a choice or the line editor (enter writes, esc leaves the file as it is; a number or a duration takes only its digits and units, + and - step it)
  d                    remove the selected key from config.toml (y confirms): what applies next is named
  D                    remove every key of the group set in config.toml (y confirms); your own backup.after_* stay
  esc q                back
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  the projects page (M)
  ↑↓ j k               move
  pgup pgdn            a page up or down
  home end             the first or the last project
  enter                the selected project: every column, its streams, its pause or suspend record, its template and workspace
  Z                    put the selected project to sleep (agentbus suspend), or wake it when it is suspended (resume); asks first
  o                    open the selected project in this busmon: it starts again on it (refused while a draft is open)
  x                    stop the selected project's services on this machine (agentbus down; deletes nothing); asks first
  b                    back the selected project up now (agentbus backup --project); the archive is the notice
  d del                delete the selected project's keys (refused while it is live; a backup offered first, its name typed)
  R                    read every project again (the page is never polled)
  esc                  back
  F1 ?                 help
  q                    quit
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  a project's delete (d on M)
  b                    the first step: back the project up, then go on (only when it succeeds)
  n                    the first step: go on without a backup
  enter                the name step: delete when the field is the project's name, byte for byte
  y                    the open project: the second confirmation; busmon exits after the delete
  esc                  cancel at every step; nothing is written
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  the notifications setup
  enter                the next step, or confirm the choice; on a field: edit it
  esc                  back one step; on step 1 or a target's page, close (nothing is written before the write step)
  ↑↓                   between choices, or between fields
  tab                  the next field (shift-tab the one before), edited at once
  y                    ntfy: copy the topic (the subscribe step, a target's page)
  Y                    ntfy: copy the subscribe link
  c                    ntfy: the code alone, full screen, until any key
  t                    send the test again (after the write, a target's page)
  e                    back to the first step, values kept
  x                    a target's page: remove it (y/n; no other key while it asks)
  n                    a target's page: rename it (enter writes)
  s                    an ntfy target's page: its topic and code, until any key
  ?                    the first step: notify.toml's format and a table to copy, to write the file by hand
  F1                   help
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  the compose window
  Ctrl+S               send
  tab                  recipient · text; a text that is only @prefix becomes the recipient (completed, or its list opens)
  Ctrl+T               after the open-question hint: answer in its question panel
  Ctrl+V               paste the clipboard's image (saved 0600 under the cache's agentbus/attachments, its path inserted once; nothing uploaded), else its text (speech-to-text tools paste this way)
  Ctrl+Z               undo the last edit: a paste whole, a run of typing or of deleting (until the window closes)
  Ctrl+Y               redo what undo took back (also ctrl+shift+z where the terminal tells it apart)
  esc                  close (draft kept)
  shift+↑↓←→ home end  select text: del or backspace removes it, typing replaces it, esc or a plain move clears it
  pgup pgdn            a page up or down (with shift: extend the selection)
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  the compose window's file list (@ in the text)
  ↑↓                   choose
  pgup pgdn            a page of the file list
  enter                insert the selected path, a file or a folder, in place of the @ and its query (no new line)
  tab                  on a folder: list its files (the query becomes the folder); on a file: insert it; in a message that holds only @ and the start of an agent's name, the recipient instead (the hint says recipient)
  esc                  close the list only, the typed @query kept; esc again closes the window
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  the first-launch tour
  enter →              next
  ←                    back
  esc                  skip
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)

  ↑↓                   select
  pgup                 page up
  pgdn                 page down
  enter                open
  esc                  close
  ^C                   quit (everywhere)
  1 2 3 (4)            medium and narrow screens: switch the visible panel
  click / wheel        click selects, click on the selected row opens it; the wheel scrolls
                       a click outside an open detail closes it, like esc
  i : @                write: @agent text wakes that agent, @all text every agent; plain text is a broadcast nobody reads (Enter twice)
  ↑ vX.Y.Z             header: a newer release exists - run ./setup.sh update (checked once a day; AGENT_BUS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 turns it off)

COMMANDS
  / at the start of the line (i or :), or Ctrl+P anywhere; Tab completes, Enter runs, // sends a /
  /requests                who owes whom an answer (F2 r); also /f2, /r, /req
  /services                the project's services, their cards and logs (F3 s); also /f3, /s, /svc
  /health                  the project's measured checks (F5); also /f5
  /help                    every key, and these commands (F1 ?); also /f1, /?
  /plan                    the plan's tasks (p P); also /p
  /recap                   what happened while you were away (R); also /R
  /triage                  walk what waits for you (T); also /T
  /tokens                  tokens per project and agent (U); also /U
  /settings                the settings page (C); also /C, /config
  /projects                every project of this host (M); also /M
  /history                 the archive and the streams, newest first (H); also /H
  /about                   versions and the bus line (A); also /A, /version
  /unread                  the next unread item for you (u); also /u
  /follow                  auto-scroll on or off (f); also /f, /autoscroll
  /all                     show or hide the agents silent for a day (a); also /a
  /compose                 the compose window (I); also /I
  /sleep                   suspend or resume the project (asks first) (Z); also /Z
  /filter [words]          filter Activity by @agent, a thread or words (/)
  /answer                  answer an agent's open questions (! F4); also /f4, /!
  /write <agent> <text>    a message to an agent (as @agent text) (@); also /@
  /master <text>           a directive to master: ask for an agent's or master's action (w)
  /set [key]               jump to a setting on the settings page (C)
  /tour                    the first-launch tour again (F1 t); also /t
  /project <project>       open another project of this broker in this busmon
  /quit                    leave busmon (q); also /q, /exit

STATES
  ● working            the state the agent DECLARED the last time it published a status.
  ○ idle               Silence never changes it: an agent that said working and went quiet
  ▲ blocked            still reads working. Any other recorded value is shown as written.
  ✓ done
  · no state declared  seen on the bus (a report, a lease) but it never published a state.
  updated              bar and age of that declaration: the bar empties over 10 minutes.
                       It measures freshness, not liveness - the bus has no heartbeat.
  ctx                  the agent's own context, in raw tokens. Never a percentage.
  sort                 attention first: escalated, gated or blocked; then queued or being woken;
                       then working, idle, other states, done, no state declared. Names inside each.

  flags
  prompt               its own client asks something in its tab (a limit menu, a permission): it reads waiting; answer it in that tab.
  swapping             agentbus swap is replacing it by its role on another profile: the dispatcher leaves its pane alone.
  reloading            agentbus reload is restarting it on the same role and profile, resumed: the dispatcher leaves its pane alone.
  retiring             agentbus retire --forget is ending this pop: its pane closes, then it is unregistered.
  self-repair          the dispatcher is relaunching this dead agent in a new pane, resumed (self-repair).
  done Nm              a pop the dispatcher judged finished N minutes ago: master was told to end it (retire --forget).
  handoff              it declared a hand-off (agentbus handoff) and has not moved on since: a fresh session can resume from its report.
  escalated            the dispatcher could not wake this agent and told the escalation target.
  escalating           that escalation is being published.
  gate N               N open 4-eyes challenges gate this agent: it must wait for a verdict.
  deferred             a wake is due but the pane was not ready (busy, focused, typed input).
  unobserved           a wake line was typed but its nonce was never seen on screen.
  waking               the dispatcher reserved a wake and is typing the line.
  woken                the nonce was echoed on the agent's screen - not proof it read or accepted anything.
  busy                 the dispatcher saw the pane running a turn while the agent does not declare working (observed, not declared).
  idle?                the agent reads working, but the dispatcher has seen its pane ready for a while (display.idle_hint_after; a hint).
  update               a newer client is installed than this agent runs: sentinel proposes a reload (/exit, then agentbus up --resume).
  pilot                holds the pilot lease (the master).
  armed                a receiver lease is live: something subscribes for this agent. A lease, not a state.
  stale N              N addressed entries older than the 24h horizon; they wake no one.
  wake:<value>         a wake state this busmon does not know, shown as stored.

  activity types
  status               a state declaration (state - message).
  report  auto         an agent's report; auto = written by a hook. (+N): more text retained.
  notify               a broadcast note; nobody reads it and nothing wakes for it.
  request              a directive carrying a tracked request (agentbus request send).
  directive  reply     a cmd to an agent, and its answer.
  challenge  verdict   4-eyes: a review request and its decision.
  escalation           the dispatcher could not wake an agent.
  blocked              a request target reports it cannot proceed.
  complete             the conductor integrated every mission of a change revision.
  board                task, owner, state and age; working, requested, accepted, blocked, done.

DELIVERY
  ● bus ok             busmon's OWN link to Redis. ▲ bus down Ns: busmon is blind,
                       the agents may be fine; values on screen are the last ones read.
  F5 health            measured project checks; unknown counts as unhealthy, and remediation is guidance only.
  F6 ideas             the project's ideas by state (to discuss, decided, doing, dropped); s sets one, the person only.
  ● dispatch up        a dispatcher holds the lease: unarmed agents are woken in their panes.
  ○ dispatch down      none runs: nothing wakes an unarmed agent. ? dispatch: not measured yet.
  ● missions up        a missions conductor runs; down: a change is loaded but no conductor runs (its work is stalled).
  used                 account windows consumed per provider (session / week), shared by every agent.
  queue                messages that would wake this agent: addressed, not wake=no, within the horizon.
                       · = measured zero, — = not measured yet, N? = last read failed.
  lag (detail)         entries in the SHARED cmd stream this agent's group has not read: not a work queue.
  gap (detail)         entries may have been trimmed before this agent read them - possible, not proven.

  requests
  requested            published and recorded; nobody has accepted it.
  accepted             the target explicitly accepted it.
  written to output    the bytes reached a subscriber's output - not proof the agent read them.
  queued               no delivery attempt is recorded - not proof none happened.
  no deadline set      the request carries no expiry; busmon never invents one.
  body not retained    the request text reads back empty; trimmed, deleted and never-existed look alike.
  untracked threads    cmd threads with no answer in the retained history; never shown as accepted.

  message text
  full text retained   the whole text is stored and shown.
  truncated at publish MARKED as cut when published; the rest was never stored. A trailing … proves nothing.
  one-line preview     nothing beyond the preview is stored for this entry.
  completeness not ma… published before the marker existed; busmon cannot promise it is whole.
  not retained         the entry reads back empty; the cause is unknown.
